description: `recalc.py` treats a command timeout (exit code 124) as non-fatal and continues to scan the workbook as if recalculation succeeded. This can silently produce stale/unrecalculated formula values while still returning `status: success` (or only reporting cell errors), undermining the script’s purpose as a mandatory formula-recalc verifier.

locations.section: recalc(): subprocess returncode handling (`if result.returncode != 0 and result.returncode != 124` ...)
